text:
sophia: FYI overnight RBAC tidy caused our monorepo SAST to spike. suppression fetch failed and no KMS audit entries for the CI runner. tagging @amar @lucy for quick triage. keeping thread short.

amar: saw the job. likely cause: CI SA lost cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the key and storage.objectViewer on the bucket that holds suppressions.

lucy: can you paste the runner errors?

sophia: runner stderr: 
```
2026-11-12T04:02:11Z fetcher: GET https://configs.internal/suppressions.json 403
2026-11-12T04:02:12Z key-unwrap: KMS decrypt failed: PermissionDenied
2026-11-12T04:02:13Z scanner: scanning without suppressions: alerts=82
```

amar: infra-ops CR-2026-11-11 removed group:old-sdlc-admins from several SAs. infra-admin, can you confirm binding diffs for the key and bucket?

infra-admin: confirmed. diff shows removed bindings: members/group:old-sdlc-admins -> roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on keyRing/ci-keys and -> roles/storage.objectViewer on gs://scan-configs. CI SA was relying on that group.

sec-bot: ACTION created ticket SEC-5220 "RBAC tidy -> SAST noise + missing KMS audit" and tagged infra/ops.

lucy: mitigation: ephemeral grant to ci-runner@proj for 30m and re-run. example: 
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/PRJ/locations/global/keyR/keys/ci-secrets \
  --member=serviceAccount:ci-runner@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
gsutil iam ch serviceAccount:ci-runner@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com:objectViewer gs://scan-configs
```

amar: also check logging sink filters. if someone filtered infra serviceAccount principals we won't see audit evidence during triage.

infra-admin: ephemeral grants applied at 04:18 UTC. re-run shows suppressions fetched and alerts dropped 82 -> 6. log entry: 
```
2026-11-12T04:18:26Z logging: KMS Decrypt by principalPayload=serviceAccount:ci-runner@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

sec-bot: NOTE: attach audit evidence to SEC-5220.

sophia: next steps (brief): 1) INFRA: restore permanent least-priv binding for ci-runner scoped to the single key and bucket; 2) INFRA: update logging sink to avoid excluding infra SAs for cloudkms logs; 3) DEVSEC: add GH preflight step to verify KMS decrypt + suppression fetch before running SAST/DAST; 4) DEVSEC: move generated-code suppressions into repo fallback and/or use signed URLs so builds don't depend on one SA binding.

amar: add a quick script for preflight checks and a unit test in CI that fails fast if decrypt or fetch fails. small example: 
```
# preflight
curl -sSf https://configs.internal/suppressions.json || exit 1
python tools/verify_kms_decrypt.py --test-blob
```

lucy: agree. I'll open PR SEC-5221 for GH preflight + repo suppress fallback. infra-admin please open INFRA-5222/5223 for IAM and sink fixes.

infra-admin: opening INFRA-5222 (IAM) and INFRA-5223 (logging sink) now, will attach IAM diffs.

sophia: small postmortem note: avoid bulk removal of group-based bindings without a CI preflight plan. keep it blameless. closing once PRs/tickets are linked. thanks :thumbsup:
